title: Metric Sentry: pluggable transform + validation runway for inference KPIs
creator: Samira Patel
description:
Problem: Our current metrics ingestion path accepts a wide variety of OTLP/Prometheus payloads and enriches them downstream. We frequently see malformed label combinations, tenant-scoped cardinality explosions, and missing trace/context linkage for per-request KPIs (latency_by_route, prompt_token_count). These issues cause noisy dashboards, SLO skew, and expensive storage.

Goal: Build a lightweight, pluggable "Metric Sentry" transform runway that sits between the OTLP/Prometheus intake and the existing ingestion fanout. The Sentry will: validate schema, normalize label sets, attach tracing hooks (trace_id/span_id) when available, apply tenant-aware cardinality guards, and optionally transform/derive custom KPI metrics (route latency percentiles, token attribution) via safe, sandboxed plugins. The design must prioritize low CPU & latency overhead and strong backpressure semantics so it can be applied at edge and regional collectors.

Scope: MVP includes: 1) schema validation & reject-to-dead-letter for clearly invalid envelopes, 2) deterministic label normalization rules (prefix stripping, reserved label hygiene), 3) header-based trace linkage & span anchor insertion for per-request aggregation, 4) a plugin interface (WASM runtime) that can implement per-tenant KPI derivations, 5) a dead-letter queue and replay workflow visible in Console, and 6) telemetry (processing latency, plugin CPU, rejected_count) exported to our observability stack.

Non-goals: Replicating full OTLP transformation feature set, long-term storage of transformed payloads, or replacing existing Prometheus scrape pipelines during MVP.
acceptance_criteria: Sentry component deployed behind the ingestion gateway with feature flag control
Schema validation rejects invalid envelopes and writes details to DLQ (dead-letter queue) with searchable metadata
Trace linkage added to metric envelopes when X-Trace or OTLP trace context present; test fixture demonstrates span anchoring across request->metric->trace
WASM plugin interface documented and one example plugin implemented: "derive_prompt_token_kpi" that emits token_count per-route
End-to-end latency from intake to fanout increases by <10% (target: <5%) in synthetic load tests at 10k rps
Monitoring dashboards in Console: sentry-processing-latency, rejected-envelope-rate, plugin-cpu, dlq-replay-rate
Rollout plan in Console with canary percentage control and automated rollback on error-rate >0.5%
Runbook and playbook created for DLQ handling and replay; at least one on-call familiarization session held
